ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels. Dark pixels cover approximately 95% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field across both lobes. Discrete white high-contrast blobs (1-5 pixel diameter) scattered across central regions. Densely packed white geometric clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; base junction is partially obscured by white-water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Smooth to low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge. High-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys at the distal tips due to epibiotic accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch to the fluke tips along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters (barnacles/scars) distributed across both lobes, with major aggregations at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, thin white linear marks (rake marks) cutting through the dark pigment, notably dense on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring and barnacle colonization at the tips of both fluke lobes; extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant encrustation at the distal fluke tips, creating a highly irregular and bright texture relative to the smooth, dark fluke body.
